description: The Daily DBR scaled by 1.79 (PL 170.41) with a flat tail, just under the Weekly supply.
explanation: spec 7.4 / RB 1302-1316: an opposing supply close overhead is a higher-timeframe conflict; Weekly is evidence-only for MIT and a 5-10% band needs judgement (P-CONF-1), so G5 is MANUAL. A MANUAL gate can never be ACTIONABLE (spec 8).
title: Weekly supply within 10% of the entry maximum: G5 MANUAL
